name: Brutus
bio: A retired legionary who never learned to step aside, and never needed to.

name: Vex
bio: A street thief who learned that the best block is not being there.

name: Hesper
bio: Keeps her opponents at arm's length, and then some.

name: Corvin
bio: Circles, waits, and strikes when the crowd least expects it.

name: Ula
bio: Bought her freedom twice and lost it at dice both times.

name: Dagny
bio: Came south with a raiding party and stayed for the applause.

name: Talos
bio: A former stonemason who fights like he builds: slowly, and to last.

name: Mira
bio: Fights with a sword in each hand and a grudge in her heart.
